description: Material Shifts and Trends: A Comprehensive Dataset of European Car Fleet Composition, 1980–2050 is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Matthias Rösslein et al. The transition to electrified drivetrains fundamentally reshapes material demand and future secondary raw material supply. However, existing vehicle composition data are often fragmented or proprietary. This study presents a harmonized, open-access dataset detailing the material and elemental composition of the European passenger car fleet (M1 category) from 1980 to 2050. Coverage: continental; published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The paper's page was read, but no repository address could be taken from its machine-readable metadata, so the record links to the article, whose Data Records section names where the data sit. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
